title: Integers representable as a difference of two rational fourth powers
summary: In Section 6.6 of the book {\it Number Theory, Volume I: Tools and Diophantine Equations, Graduate Texts in Mathematics, Volume 239, Springer (2007)}, Cohen investigated the solubility of the equation $n=x^4+y^4$ in the rational numbers $x,y$ for all positive integers $n \leq 10000$. Motivated by this, we investigate the equation $n=x^4-y^4$ and obtain the complete list of positive integers $n\leq 10000$ that can be represented in this form for some nonzero rational numbers $x$ and $y$.
